title: Dumb Patrick
blurb: Bikini Bottom's most confidently unintelligent resident, preserved in audio. Patrick Star has spent a quarter of a century being wrong with absolute conviction and no discernible shame, and that combination made him the internet's patron saint of the bad take. He is never uncertain. A hesitant idiot is sad; a certain one is comedy. Play it when somebody says something so misguided it deserves a starfish's formal endorsement, or use it on yourself after working out, several hours late, what the meeting was actually about. Is mayonnaise an instrument?
origin: Patrick Star's iconic dim-witted delivery from SpongeBob SquarePants.
